findings.explanation: The raw call index and call graph are correct; method orderedSteps stops before synchronized statements and loses calls/conditions/assignments/returns inside4blocks across Operations,TransferDraft,Web.

findings.title: Explicit superclass constructor omitted from method orderedSteps and callTargets
findings.explanation: BankException super(message) now resolves in the call index and graph, but its method callTargets is empty and orderedSteps has only subsequent assignments.

findings.title: Explicit this.field writes misclassified as local assignments when a parameter shares the field name
findings.explanation: Java name resolution for this.field is unambiguously the field; the extractor tests parameter shadowing before considering the explicit this scope. Six writes are labeled assignment while this.id without a matching parameter is correctly field-write.
